packageRules.description: Stay on the PostgreSQL 16 branch used by upstream bigbluebutton/docker (postgres:16-alpine): a major bump needs the pgdata volume path and greenlight/graphql schema compat reviewed first

Docker versioning only considers a candidate tag when it has the same number of version parts and the same suffix as the current one, and it ranks a shorter tag as newer. greenlight v3.8.2 therefore never sees v3.8.2.4. Loose versioning compares part by part without that constraint; allowedVersions keeps the flavour tags out, since loose ignores the suffix.

The alangecker tags carry a compatibility suffix (-v3.0.23, -v5.4.4-1.29, -s8328b77-p88f3f6b) that docker versioning requires to stay identical, so an upgrade is never offered. Group them in a single PR: mixing BigBlueButton component versions is not supported upstream.
